lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet installed 1883fef with all 30 runtime JSON hashes preserved, then held server handoff because Python pidfd wrappers were unavailable.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use a held proc directory descriptor, revalidate owner, cwd, exact launcher and start time through that descriptor, and call native libc pidfd_send_signal in an isolated bounded child; retain HOLD on unsupported native calls and enable images only after exact running/disk SHA agreement.
validation_required: Missing wrappers, reused identity, helper errors, SIGSYS and timeout regressions
Native Linux integration against an owned fixture launcher, separate from physical Android verification
Scheduler disappearing-proc stderr and retained six update guidance tests
Exact successor lineage, current-head integrity and protected CI
lessons.safety_boundary: No numeric PID kill fallback, source/learning reset, private image/model upload, calibration change or invented physical-tablet verification.
